name: Navy Federal cashRewards Credit Card

apr.notes: As of 10/22/2026, purchase, balance transfer and convenience check APR 14.15% to 18.00% based on creditworthiness and product type; cash advance APR 18%; penalty APR 18%. 1.99% intro APR for 12 months from account opening on balance transfers made within the first 60 days.

base_rate.description: Unlimited 1.5% cash back on all purchases.

rewards.redemption_notes: Cash back accrues with no cap until redeemed.

signup_bonus.description: $250 bonus cash back after $2,500 in eligible purchases within 90 days of account opening.

notes: Navy Federal issues cashRewards as cashRewards (1.5%) when the approved credit limit is under $5,000 and as cashRewards Plus (2%) when it is $5,000 or more. Membership in Navy Federal Credit Union is required. The card is offered as cashRewards Visa or cashRewards Mastercard.
